question: In which year was the Dandi March by Mahatma Gandhi launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1930**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi launched the **Dandi March **in the year **1930**.
 
• The Dandi March, also known as the **Salt March**, was a significant event in the Indian independence movement.
 
• It was a nonviolent protest against the British salt monopoly in colonial India.
 
• The march started on **March 12, 1930, and ended on April 6, 1930**, covering a distance of **240 miles** from **Sabarmati Ashram to the coastal village of Dandi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dandi March was part of Gandhi's broader strategy of nonviolent resistance, known as Satyagraha.
 
• It drew worldwide attention to the Indian independence cause and inspired numerous movements for civil rights and freedom across the world.
 
• The march marked the beginning of the Civil Disobedience Movement in India, which aimed at defying British laws and policies through nonviolent means.
 
• The Salt March is considered a pivotal event in the history of India's struggle for independence from British rule.
